chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from Sandal, from Yazid ibn Khalifa, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever regularly recites the Surah and An-Najm every day or every night, he will live praiseworthy among people, will be forgiven, and will be beloved among people.

key_terms.السُّورَةِ وَالنَّجْمِ: The Surah and An-Najm (referring to Surah An-Najm)
key_terms.يُدْمِنُ: Regularly recites / makes a habit of

ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of regularly reciting Surah An-Najm according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-Amal*, this hadith emphasizes the social and spiritual fruits of habitual recitation of Surah An-Najm, linking it to a praiseworthy reputation (*mahmudan*) and divine favor (*mawfur*). In Shia tradition, this practice is viewed not merely as ritual but as a means of cultivating inner purity that manifests as popularity and acceptance among the community.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from Sandal from Yazid b. Khalifa from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:

Whoever regularly recites Surah Najm during the day or night would become praiseworthy and conspicuous among the people, would be forgiven (his sins) and would become popular and amiable among the people.
